{{Top|leg}}
A '''datapacket''' was a collection of information that could be produced in bulk and handed out to a variety of individuals. Passengers aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] were handed datapackets containing a variety of information regarding the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] itself and its projected journey.
